files.masters: 2x PNG at <kind>/_2x/<id>.png, draw at scale 0.5 (identical placement)

anchors.tile: image bottom-centre on the cell diamond SOUTH tip (board/tile.gd): draw at cell_to_local(cell, elev) + (-w/2, 16 - h). Floor/decal tiles are 64x32, so the image IS the diamond.
anchors.side_strip: 32x26 strip per height step k (0 = just under the top): left face top-left = south_tip + (-32, -16 + 10k), right face top-left = south_tip + (0, -16 + 10k); south_tip of the LIFTED tile. Optional upgrade over painted placeholder faces.
anchors.prop: image bottom-centre on the SOUTH tip of the footprint's south-most cell (max x+y; for 2x2 = origin+(1,1)), lifted by that cell's height: draw at cell_to_local(south_cell, elev) + (0,16) + (-w/2, -h). NW origin only defines the covered cells.
anchors.y_sort: sort by the footprint south-most cell (x+y). If you use a y-sort point instead, use image bottom - 16 px (centre of the south-most cell) and break ties in favour of characters.

v2_art_pass.summary: Wakfu-style quality pass: painterly brushwork + warm/cool hue shifts on all floor families, stronger turf-lip AO, deeper water with shallows/foam/glints, continuous tall cliff faces with grass overhang and under-lip AO, scalloped leaf canopies, coloured soft outlines, height AO and non-clipped contact shadows on props. All v1 ids, file names, pixel sizes and anchors unchanged.
v2_art_pass.caveat: walk-through decor and ground decals are additive only: zone data (WorldZone) cannot reference them yet; Backend must add a decor layer. Blocking new props need zone-data blockers.
v2_art_pass.external_textures: Scenario textures (art/pc/crosshaven_world/scenario/{golden_plains,dirt_road,water,cliff_rock,cobble}_{1,2}.png) are blended into the base fills by tools/cw_paint.py (top surfaces rotated 45deg + squashed 2:1, cliff_rock unrotated on faces, colour-matched, high-passed); painted AO/edge/lighting overlays on top. Sampling is per cell (tile PNGs repeat per cell); seamless world-space texturing would need a Godot shader.

surface_textures.method: per-face affine projection in the iso direction (roof planes: s along eave, t eave->ridge, tile count locked to the painted tile grid, ~5-6 px per tile at 1x; walls: texture repeat 52 px plaster / 36 px planks / 44 px stone at 1x), colour = texture ratio x palette colour x the face's soft painted light; outlines, timbers, windows, painterly, outline_v2 and contact AO drawn on top
surface_textures.assignment: roof hue -> teal (blue/cool: smithy, tavern, bakery, slate cottages, spire roofs), terracotta (red/orange: Southbridge, Westwatch), thatch (straw: Eastmarch, fishing hut, farmhouse); plaster faces -> plaster; wood faces + timber beams + docks/fences/carts -> planks; stone faces (bases, town walls, Northgate, smithy, cottage_stone) -> mossy stone
